title: India showcases steel sector strength and Russia partnership at INNOPROM India 2026
dek: DD News reports that India showcased the strength of its steel sector and its partnership with Russia at INNOPROM India 2026.
summary: DD News reports that India showcased the strength of its steel sector and its partnership with Russia at INNOPROM India 2026. The publisher provided no excerpt, so details of any agreements or participants are not available.

implications: Readers should watch for any concrete supply or technology agreements arising from the event; the headline alone does not indicate any.
